title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente.
In a separate pan, cook the pancetta until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
In a bowl, beat the eggs and mix in the Pecorino and Parmesan cheeses. Season with black pepper.
Drain the spaghetti, reserving some of the cooking water. Add the spaghetti to the pan with pancetta and toss to combine.

Remove the pan from heat and quickly pour in the egg and cheese mixture, tossing vigorously to create a creamy sauce. If the sauce is too thick, add a little of the reserved cooking water to loosen it.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and black pepper on top.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt and tikka masala spice mix for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight.
Grill the chicken until cooked through and slightly charred. Set aside.
In a pan, sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger until soft. Add the canned tomatoes and cook until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the heavy cream and add the grilled chicken to the sauce. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until the chicken is fully coated and the flavors meld together.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice or naan bread.

title: Beef Stir Fry
summary: Tender beef strips cooked with fresh vegetables in a savory sauce.
instructions: In a bowl, mix the beef with soy sauce, oyster sauce, and cornstarch. Let it marinate for 15 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over high heat. Add the beef and stir-fry until browned. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the bell pepper and broccoli, and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
